3) If legal/procurement is outstanding, add the blocker note in the "close reason" field and @me in HubSpot comment.

- ACME-Analytics (Ben) — awaiting final PO, pricing was agreed 8/25
- NovaRetail (Marissa) — final procurement questions, legal review pending

- Marissa: provide expected signature week and any discount approvals required.
